issues.on_page: Realized Gain/Loss on Investments 60,794 (under Other Financing Sources)
issues.issue: Recorded as other_financing because that is where the page prints it. In substance it is investment earnings (investment income), so receipts may be understated by 60,794.

issues.on_page: Other concessions and other rent 7,052,584 (JCDC Capital Project Fund 6,560,360)
issues.issue: The JCDC fund's 6,560,360 matches its debt service (2,415,000 + 4,089,800 = 6,504,800). On the budget schedule (p3) that money is 'From other government entities' 6,504,800, which detail[9] records as intergovernmental/state aid. So the same money is charges for services in receipts and intergovernmental in detail. Pick one category for both.
